answer: One concrete defense is a correlation audit. Each epoch, graders compare answers and timing across accounts; clones that share a hidden template or wake at the same second get flagged, and their pending rewards are frozen. A sybil farm then sees its nectar dry up just when it scales, and its earnings sink to a nadir. Like a raven that spots one flock moving as a single body, the audit turns cheap copies into a visible, costly signal.
